summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan: ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found from reading the code (no changes made) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `schema.ts`, plus `modules/auth` and `db/auth.ts`. Contrary to the ticket's assumption, I could **not** find an obvious wiring bug by static review:  - Client fetches `/watchlist` on mount via the shared `api` wrapper, which sends `credentials: "include"` — no localStorage/anonymous fallback exists anywhere in the watchlist code. - Login looks up the existing user by email
